runs.text: The cells used an electrolyte of

runs.quote: 1 M NaPF6 in diethylene glycol dimethyl ether (diglyme)

runs.text: . It was chosen for its stability against sodium metal and its tendency to form stable SEI layers for sodium-based chemistries. The full cells with the pre-sodiated pyrite cathode were built with this diglyme-based electrolyte, in line with pyrite work on diglyme-based electrolytes.

rendered: The cells used an electrolyte of 1 M NaPF6 in diethylene glycol dimethyl ether (diglyme)[1]. It was chosen for its stability against sodium metal and its tendency to form stable SEI layers for sodium-based chemistries. The full cells with the pre-sodiated pyrite cathode were built with this diglyme-based electrolyte, in line with pyrite work on diglyme-based electrolytes.[2][3]
